parameters.jsonBody:
=
{{ JSON.stringify({
  statement: `
    MERGE (d:Document {id: $docId})
    SET d.title = $title,
        d.source = $source

    MERGE (c:Chunk {id: $chunkId})
    SET c.text = $text,
        c.position = $position,
        c.source = $source

    MERGE (d)-[:HAS_CHUNK]->(c)

    WITH c
    UNWIND $conceptIds AS conceptId

    MATCH (k:Concept {id: conceptId})
    MERGE (c)-[:ABOUT]->(k)

    RETURN c.id AS chunkId,
           collect(k.name) AS concepts
  `,
  parameters: $json
}) }}
